original: WPRPLACE is a mountain range shared by southwestern Bulgaria and southeastern North Macedonia. The highest peak of the mountain is located in North Macedonia, WPRPLACEec at 1,744 m, while the highest in Bulgaria is Bilska Chuka at 1,644 m.
